sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Ever wished Cap Cut was open- source, private, and not constantly begging for subscriptions? Open Cut delivers exactly that. A clean cross-platform video editor that keeps your content where it belongs on your device. Think Cap Cut Energy, but built by devs who actually get it. Timeline editing, multitrack support, real-time previews, and zero watermarks or payw walls. It runs on the web, desktop, and mobile. If you care about privacy, simplicity, and control over your content, Open Cut is absolutely worth watching.
